reproduces: A personal site whose nav links to a resume section, with a contact form underneath. The word 'resume' is genuinely on this page and it still is not an application form — the difference is that nobody can upload anything here.
reconstructed: Everything. The anchor element carrying name=resume is the shape that broke the gate: the name attribute predates id for in-page anchors and is still written that way, so an unscoped `[name*="resume" i]` scored a personal site the strongest signal the extension has. Spelled out in prose rather than as markup because the corpus guard rejects an angle bracket followed by a letter, which is how it catches a pasted outerHTML — the element itself is declared in `elements` below, where it belongs. The contact fields are the ordinary three.

page.text: Hi, I build data pipelines. Scroll down for my resume, or get in touch below.
